text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I'm sorry, Trainer. I lost.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's frustrating, but... I suppose this is 
just the limit of my current ability...
choice_data_list: But you're not at your limit yet
Let's refocus and get fired up again!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Thank you very much for your kind 
words!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That's right, the current me hasn't hit 
her limit! I'm still just the most average 
of average!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, I'll do my best in 
training again! For now, my goal is an 
average that's just a little bit above 
average!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All right! By the next race, I'll build up 
enough strength to take 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Please help me think of what kind of 
training I should do!
